active_roadmap.title: Roadmap cockpit-mcp-broadcast: the owner orders a broadcast through an assistant, and the broadcast list shows it

items.outcome: every stored broadcast records how it was ordered (panel or MCP and its client), and the broadcast list and detail page show it next to the sender
an assistant with write access sends a broadcast over MCP through `sendBroadcast`, marked `mcp` on the list
an assistant reads the broadcasts (`list_broadcasts`) and one broadcast's per-project state (`get_broadcast`) over MCP
an assistant retries a failed project's send over MCP, as the panel's Retry does

queued.title: Roadmap later: what the owner put off
queued.start_condition: the owner picks an item up

owner_queue.text: **CMP-12**: turn the digest on: in Resend verify the sending domain and create an API key; in the `production` environment set the secrets `RESEND_API_KEY` and `MAILING_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET` (`openssl rand -base64 32`) and `DIGEST_RECIPIENTS` (`SOFTURE_EMAIL_KEY_SECRET` is already set), and the variables `MAIL_FROM` and optionally `DIGEST_AT`; after the following deploy the run checks the first digest and its unsubscribe link (README, "The digest in production"). Today these secrets are empty (deploy run 45375144586). (carried over from cockpit-v2)

**CMP-18**: to publish the CLI, store a granular npm token (read and write on the `@softure-ai` scope) as `NPM_TOKEN` in the `npm` environment and give the word to publish `@softure-ai/cockpit` 0.7.0 (`publish-cli` has never run) (carried over from cockpit-v2)

**CMP-20**: to invite teammates, run `npx softure-deploy run --host=<ssh alias> grant-role --email=<owner> --role=admin --commit`; the invitation mail needs the digest's mail settings above (carried over from cockpit-v2)

**CMP-21** (optional): to show health from observability, set the variable `GRAFANA_URL` and the secret `GRAFANA_TOKEN` (a Grafana service account that may read alert rules) in the `production` environment; today `GRAFANA_TOKEN` is empty (carried over from cockpit-v2)

**CT-10**: before the release that carries CT-10, set the secret `ROUTINE_TOKEN_SECRET` (`openssl rand -base64 32`; never change it afterwards, or every stored routine token has to be pasted again) in the `production` environment; then, per project, set up its COCKPIT command routine (`routines/cockpit-command.md` of `@softure-ai/skills` 0.40), paste the fire URL and token on the project's Routines tab and press Test (carried over from cockpit-v4)
